_comment: Contract terms in force when the golden runs were executed. Universe.Contract is overwritten by every cBot run (UpdatedBy Autosave), so these values are NOT recoverable from the database later. Re-running a golden without pinning them will not reproduce it.

Replay._comment: There is NO CLI flag combination that reproduces Accurate contract fees. Verified 2026-09-11 against Backtesting.py. CommissionType.Amount is a FLAT charge per trade, not per million, so --commission-value 45.0 would charge 45 every trade. SwapType.Points multiplies by PointSize while Accurate/Pips multiplies by PipSize, which are 10x apart on every pair here. Reproducing a golden therefore requires Accurate plus a Universe.Contract row holding exactly the values above - and that row is overwritten by every online cBot run (UpdatedBy Autosave). Until the engine can take a pinned contract, verify the row against this file before any replay and treat a mismatch as invalidating.
Replay.Precondition: Universe.Contract for Spotware(cTrader) matches Tickers above
Replay.Gap: PLAN.md 3.10 - pin contract terms per run
